contract.canonical_document_store: existing ResearchDocument in FilesystemResearchCatalogStore; checksum-protected catalog JSON
contract.artifact_store: existing immutable content-addressed artifacts published through artifact port; no second fidelity store
contract.chunk_projection: existing scoped chunk_manifest.json under paper storage; source/parser/chunker pipeline fingerprint and chunk IDs
contract.execution: existing Harness ResearchParserExecutionAdapter and registered execution profile; direct parser subprocess disabled
contract.default_rollout: unchanged Marker default/parser selection; no new reading-order or OCR/ROI recovery profile enabled
contract.fidelity_versioning: schema_version, normalization_version, source_hash, parser_fingerprint, profile_fingerprint, content_checksum

size_evidence.kind: cached synthetic concatenated 25-page raster batch diagnostic
size_evidence.limitation: Samples are artificial batches, not true papers; 16 MiB is the configured artifact-write ceiling, not an empirically proven production safe size.

known_gaps: Runtime configured artifact limit may be lower than the default.
Parse, chunk manifest, and index updates do not share an atomic snapshot switch; do not treat these records as one promoted snapshot.
Parse cache fingerprint hashes implementation modules and selected env inputs but does not yet fully bind every instance policy/configuration identity.
